description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom migration change that converts orderer associations from user IDs to provider IDs within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for retrieving relevant users and providers, updating order records, and handling database transactions.

classes.name: ConvertOrderersToProviders
classes.description: A class implementing Liquibase's CustomTaskChange to migrate orderer associations from users to providers in the database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database migration by converting user-based orderers to provider-based orderers.

methods.name: getUsersAndProviders
methods.description: Retrieves pairs of user IDs and provider IDs for users who are orderers.

methods.name: convertOrdererToProvider
methods.description: Updates the orders table, replacing user IDs with provider IDs, and sets null orderers to an 'Unknown Provider'.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a string confirming the migration completion.

methods.description: Placeholder for resource accessor setup; no implementation provided.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation; currently returns null indicating no validation errors.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors by rolling back the transaction and throwing a CustomChangeException.
